spanish.r-pictures.e1.0013.problem: Pictures B (Portuguese flag) and E (Portuguese) both fit (a) 'portuguesa' and (b) 'el portugués', so the two answers are interchangeable.
spanish.r-pictures.e1.0013.fix: Make E clearly the language (e.g. a speech bubble 'Olá' / a Portuguese textbook) or change one sentence to another nationality/language.

spanish.r-short.a1.0001.problem: Text has a factual error (Guayaquil is on the equator, so winter days are not 'muy cortos') and an internal contradiction (exams start next month, yet he was late for an English exam yesterday).
spanish.r-short.a1.0001.fix: Set the blog in a non-equatorial city (e.g. Santiago, Chile) and change 'examen de inglés' to 'clase de inglés'.
